name: cropotter
description: Turn local shipping-label PDFs into print-ready 4 × 6 PDF, PNG and ZIP files.
long_description: Format shipping labels locally with CropOtter. Preserve portrait 4 × 6 proportions, at least ⅛ inch white margins and barcode content. Analyze first, review uncertain crops, choose a filename and export PDF, PNG or ZIP. Conversion runs on your Mac; results shared with Claude follow Anthropic's data policy. Choose a workspace folder during setup and keep inputs and outputs there. No CropOtter account, API key, subscription, remote conversion service or separate Node installation is required. This bundle requires macOS 13.5+ on Apple Silicon or Intel; it does not provide direct printing or automatic access to chat attachments.

tools.name: cropotter_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a local PDF inside the chosen workspace without returning document text or barcode values.

tools.name: cropotter_convert
tools.description: Create reviewed 4 × 6 PDF/PNG/ZIP files inside the chosen workspace without overwriting existing files.

workspace.title: Label workspace
workspace.description: Choose a private folder for label PDFs and converted files. CropOtter accepts input and output paths only inside this folder. Save chat attachments here before requesting conversion.
